mapper.select: SELECT medication_id, item_name, entp_name, material_name, etc_otc_code, efficacy, usage_dosage FROM medications WHERE medication_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT ingr_a_name, ingr_b_name, taboo_type, taboo_effect, age_base, grade, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at FROM medication_interactions WHERE taboo_type IN (1, 2, 3, 4) AND ( LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(ingr_a_name, '[[:space:]]', '')) IN #{name} OR (taboo_type = 4 AND LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(ingr_b_name, '[[:space:]]', '')) IN #{name}) ) ORDER BY taboo_type, ingr_a_name, ingr_b_name, grade, age_base, taboo_effect, updated_at

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'P:' || TO_CHAR(i.item_id) AS registration_id, 'PRESCRIPTION' AS source, m.medication_id, m.item_name, m.entp_name, TO_CHAR(p.dispensed_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(p.dispensed_date) + i.total_days - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, i.usage_timing AS notes, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(5)) AS take_time FROM prescriptions p JOIN prescription_items i ON i.prescription_id = p.prescription_id JOIN medications m ON m.medication_id = i.medication_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND TRUNC(p.dispensed_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS DATE)) AND TRUNC(p.dispensed_date) + i.total_days > TRUNC(CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS DATE)) UNION ALL SELECT 'C:' || TO_CHAR(c.cabinet_id), 'CABINET', m.medication_id, m.item_name, m.entp_name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(500)), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(5)) FROM cabinet_medications c JOIN medications m ON m.medication_id = c.medication_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT 'R:' || TO_CHAR(r.routine_id), 'ROUTINE', CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)), r.supplement_name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)), r.notes, r.take_time FROM routine_medications r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY CASE source WHEN 'PRESCRIPTION' THEN 1 WHEN 'CABINET' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, item_name, registration_id
